mentions.name: deepclause-sdk
mentions.description: An SDK that compiles Markdown specs for spec-driven development (SDD) or subagents into executable logic, such as CodeAct, DSPy, and Prolog.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://www.github.com/deepclause/deepclause-sdk

"Compile" Markdown specs for SDD or Subagents into executable logic, e.g. CodeAct+DSPy+Prolog. Not sure how and if I will continue, but it's been lots of fun.
